concepts.gloss_en: converts and penitents (whose making/return elevates the Divine glory)

reason_for_human: Both occurrences are the identical phrase in the very same sentence of lm1:14 — 'גֵּרִים וּבַעֲלֵי־תְּשׁוּבָה שֶׁעוֹשִׂין'. The longer surface form only appends the relative clause שעושין ('that one creates'); it is the same core concept, not a homograph or distinct term. Clean merge.
